✓ MULTI-TRIGGER WORKFLOWS (34/73 workflows = 46.6%)
  └─ Most common: schedule + workflow_dispatch (8 workflows)
     Allows both automated + manual execution
  
  Example patterns:
  • 📅 + ⏱️  (Schedule + Manual)    - Automated runs + emergency manual override
  • 🔄 + ⏱️  (Push + Manual)        - Post-merge + on-demand execution
  • 🔄 + 🔄 (PR + Push)            - Different event types
  • 🚀 + ⏱️  (Release + Manual)     - Release events + manual trigger

✓ GATE-HEAVY ARCHITECTURE
  └─ 21 workflows (28.8%) specifically for governance/approval
  └─ Multi-stage validation: PR → Document → Release
  └─ Supports compliance and quality requirements

✓ SECURITY-FIRST APPROACH
  └─ 6 dedicated security workflows
  └─ Mix of continuous (CodeQL) and on-demand (DAST, Fortify, Fuzzing)

✓ MODULAR DESIGN
  └─ 18 reusable/composite workflows (24.7%)
  └─ Supports workflow chaining and parameterization
